name: G-001 Tracker
description: The G-001 Tracker was a laser cannon produced by CoMar Combat Systems. It was the predecessor of the G-003 Tri-Tracker. Two versions were used: a double turret medium laser and a single turret light laser. The Mortex Sector HQ on Fangol was equipped with nine G-001; three double turret weapons and six single turret weapons.
